picks.question: Strait of Hormuz traffic returns to normal by December 31?
picks.why: About a fifth of global oil passes through Hormuz, so prolonged disruption shapes energy prices, shipping costs, and inflation worldwide.

picks.question: Billionaire one-time wealth tax passes in California election 2026?
picks.why: A state-level wealth tax would test how mobile capital and top earners respond, with consequences for state revenue and tax design.

picks.question: Will inflation reach more than 4.5% in 2026?
picks.why: Inflation re-accelerating past 4.5% would challenge Federal Reserve credibility and reshape expectations for interest rates and bond yields.

picks.question: Will real GDP increase by more than 2.0% in Q3 2026?
picks.why: Third-quarter growth above 2% would signal an economy resilient to tariffs and tight policy, affecting rate and earnings outlooks.

picks.question: Will Anthropic have the best AI model at the end of December 2026?
picks.why: Which lab leads frontier AI influences where investment, talent, and market power concentrate in a strategically important industry.

picks.question: Will an AI lab announce another Millennium Prize solution by December 31, 2027?
picks.why: AI solving a famous unsolved math problem would show that machines can produce frontier research, with large implications for productivity.
